Docs.summary: Blittable JNI native method registration for use with raw function pointers. Layout matches JNI's JNINativeMethod struct exactly.
Docs.remarks: This value stores raw pointers. It does not allocate, copy, or free the name and signature buffers, and does not keep a managed callback alive.
